subject.title: feat(onboard): guided onboarding becomes the custodian flow

question: Should guided onboarding permanently persist discovery consent and default fresh local installs to automatic setup application plus TUI hatching once the baseline-completion defect is fixed?
rationale: The change establishes a new persisted config contract and replaces a public setup handoff, so correctness alone cannot decide the intended long-term onboarding policy.

options.title: Adopt after completion fix
options.body: Keep the custodian flow, replace the broad gateway-object guard with a canonical completion signal, and require fresh-install plus upgrade-path proof.

options.title: Split behavior from policy
options.body: Land the quiet inference and consent improvements first while retaining the legacy chat handoff until the auto-apply contract is separately approved.

options.title: Retain legacy onboarding
options.body: Drop the persisted access-mode and automatic hatch direction and keep guided onboarding as verification followed by system-agent chat.

recommendation.title: Adopt after completion fix
recommendation.body: Keep the custodian flow, replace the broad gateway-object guard with a canonical completion signal, and require fresh-install plus upgrade-path proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent ownership signal across the onboarding implementation, current setup documentation, and the redesign direction.
